**Finding: compliant (preferred level).**

- **Section 3.19 (p0369)** is the only exclusivity covenant, and it binds **SFJ** and its Affiliates during the Exclusive Period (defined at 1.1.68, p0085 — clinical trials to 21 Nov 2022; sale/offer for sale to 21 Nov 2024) in respect of Competing Products and Brilinta Competing Products. Exclusivity in our favour is expressly acceptable and not redlined.
- **Article 4 (p0380–p0381)** is a funding cap/obligation on SFJ ($120M Maximum Development Costs), not a commitment by PB to source from SFJ.
- **Section 7.5.5 (p0552)** requires SFJ consent for a Licensing Transaction, but expressly excludes Excluded Licensing Transactions — including licences to service providers, CROs and CMOs — so PB stays free to engage alternative suppliers and manufacturers. Any residual restrictive-covenant concern there belongs under NONCOMPETE and is not double-flagged here.
- No "sole supplier", "all of its requirements", or third-party procurement prohibition binds PB anywhere in the document.

No redline proposed.
